entries.0087e89ce204a4e4: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, it recorded a net loss attributable to owners of the parent of ¥123 million.
entries.0d5b0ad550ce8cca: This business is undertaken by the company and three domestic consolidated subsidiaries (FTC Co., Ltd., Shion Co., Ltd., and Knit Material Co., Ltd.). It manufactures sewing thread, embroidery thread and various crafts threads, and sells them to domestic customers and overseas Group companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,333 million.
entries.1708e616d29c1fac: The [Management Policy, Business Environment and Issues to Be Addressed] section states that the share in the Asian sewing thread market is low and leaves room for growth, and that the share in Western markets is extremely low.
entries.1f316273e44deaff: The [History] section records the founding in 1921 and the development of synthetic fiber sewing machine thread in 1951, and the [Business Overview] section records the manufacturing and sales structure of consolidated subsidiaries in China, Vietnam and Thailand.
entries.2834ae373d5d1357: This business is undertaken by seven overseas consolidated subsidiaries in China, Vietnam and Thailand. It manufactures industrial sewing thread and embroidery thread and sells them to customers in China, other Asian countries, Hong Kong and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,140 million.
entries.32122aef092bbcb7: This business is undertaken by seven overseas consolidated subsidiaries in China, Vietnam and Thailand.
entries.339ca62b822f9e79: It delivers its products through its own sales network and those of its Japanese and Asian subsidiaries to sewing manufacturers such as apparel makers, embroidery businesses and people who enjoy handicrafts.
entries.375dec14b3317655: Sewing manufacturers and people who enjoy handicrafts
entries.37bb56a524dee610: Sales of sewing thread, embroidery thread and various craft threads
entries.478ee37f76355845: With eliminating the loss as the first priority, for industrial sewing thread it will reassess customer needs and purchasing preferences, and based on a new sales strategy, rebuild its manufacturing and sales structure in Japan and overseas, aiming to expand its share in the Asian region. In handicraft and hobby-related fields, it will focus on creating opportunities for handicrafts in Japan to stimulate demand, and aims to expand sales to Western countries and other Asian countries by proposing highly original products.
entries.4bdc581d72a30d77: This business is undertaken by the company and three domestic consolidated subsidiaries (FTC Co., Ltd., Shion Co., Ltd., and Knit Material Co., Ltd.).
entries.718e4415070af560: It manufactures industrial and household sewing thread, embroidery thread and various craft threads. In 1951 it launched Japan's first synthetic fiber sewing machine thread, 'King-jirushi Nylon Sewing Machine Thread'.
entries.84a481ddd9e75ae1: FUJIX Ltd. is a sewing thread manufacturer headquartered in Kita-ku, Kyoto, and conducts its business together with 10 consolidated subsidiaries. Consolidated headcount as of March 31, 2026 was 346.
entries.a65c6cffeec3e9c3: The company views the group's share of the Asian sewing thread market as low, and sees room for growth through share expansion by strengthening competitiveness, including adapting its production structure. Its products' share of the Western handicraft market is also extremely low, and it states that there is potential to expand sales by proposing highly original products.
entries.aba480be46e1ea54: Manufacture of sewing thread, embroidery thread and craft thread
entries.cf3dc06899821090: A Kyoto-based textile manufacturer that makes sewing thread, embroidery thread and handicraft thread, and sells them worldwide, mainly in Japan and Asia.
entries.e29dd2160f97155c: Net loss for the period ¥123 million
entries.ea168032e1f368d5: Since its founding in 1921, it has built up technology and product development as a sewing thread specialist, and it has a track record of developing Japan's first synthetic fiber sewing machine thread in 1951. It has production and sales bases in China, Vietnam and Thailand, and a structure that enables it to supply local sewing manufacturers across Asia, where garment sewing production is shifting.
entries.f0a86e1af46d2c48: The company and its domestic and overseas subsidiaries manufacture sewing thread, embroidery thread and craft threads, and generate revenue by selling them to sewing manufacturers and people who enjoy handicrafts.
entries.f7947af8eb1361fa: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,474 million, down 3.0% from the previous fiscal year. By region, Japan accounted for ¥4,333 million and Asia for ¥1,140 million.
